resolved.question: v1-quality-r3c brief: what is the correct test shape for BREHON_DISABLE_FED_REPLAY_CLEANUP_JOB guard test? The brief says "call the scheduler tick" but the cleanup runs in an inline scheduler closure with no standalone function.
options: option-a: call delete_older_than() directly with window_days=1 and a seeded old row; set guard and assert row is NOT deleted (direct DB-function probe)
option-b: invoke the scheduler closure indirectly via a test harness; assert no DB mutations
resolved.context: Confirmed by reading scheduled_tasks.rs:396-461: the cleanup calls federation_inbox_nonce::delete_older_than(window_days_i64, conn) inline in a scheduler closure. delete_older_than is at crates/db_schema/src/source/governance/federation_inbox_nonce.rs:37. FederationInboxNonceInsertForm at line 30 has peer_instance: String + activity_id: String fields. delete_older_than deletes rows with seen_at < now()-window_days.
resolved.answer: option-a: The guard test must call delete_older_than() directly (not via the scheduler) because the scheduler closure is not callable from test context. Test shape: (1) seed a FederationInboxNonceInsertForm row with seen_at = now()-30days via diesel INSERT; (2) set EnvVarGuard BREHON_DISABLE_FED_REPLAY_CLEANUP_JOB=1; (3) call delete_older_than(1, &mut conn) directly — since the guard is checked OUTSIDE the function (in the closure body above the delete_older_than call), the test cannot test the guard via the function call alone; instead the test should mirror the guard check inline: if std::env::var(...)=="1" { skip assertion }; alternatively, the test tests the FUNCTION in isolation (seeded row is deleted when gate is not set; not deleted when gate is set AND we skip the call). RECOMMENDED: two tests — (a) gate=unset + call => row deleted; (b) gate=set + call => still call the function (guard is in the scheduler, not the function) but the test verifies the function deletes when called — then separately test the guard at integration level by asserting the scheduler path is not exercised. SIMPLEST viable test: one test that sets the guard and verifies no rows are deleted from federation_inbox_nonce (by directly querying the count) after a simulated scheduler tick interval. The plan §13 IMPLEMENT should describe this shape explicitly, citing federation_inbox_nonce.rs:30 for the insert form and :37 for delete_older_than.
